failures: server_positive_speed: Server published flyingSpeed=0.0 while flying
fallback_positive_speed: After zero-speed packet + cleared controller state + client realm2, release left flyingSpeed=0
fixture: Independent generated survival world. Ordinary double-space flight entry and W movement use client KeyMapping input and production controller; flight is never pre-enabled for these paths. One explicit zero-speed ClientboundPlayerAbilitiesPacket plus cleared state/client realm2 models the reported fallback failure.
inputScope: Logical KeyMapping press/release states on the isolated client; no native physical keyboard events or GLFW modifier-state certification. Left Shift sprint and left Control crouch are remapped and both hold/toggle settings are exercised.
movementScope: Actual client/server position changes and flight flags, not renderer submission counters. Server snapshots run on the integrated-server thread and can trail client samples by a tick.
